subject: nova-bennet
label: Nova died died
field: The universe's fourth intervention — or fifth
from: DISPUTED. The Archive had written that the universe brought Nova back and could not tell whether Viraena gave it that or it invented it
to: CANON. SHE DIED DIED. THE UNIVERSE BROUGHT HER BACK
note:
q-nova-universe IS CLOSED AND THE ARCHIVE WAS NOT MAKING IT UP.

This one mattered because the Archive had just been caught inventing a category — c-universe-four, the four women the universe gifted cocks to — and Nova was explicitly NOT among them. The Archive could not tell whether her resurrection was something it had been told or something it had assembled to fill a pattern, so it flagged its own uncertainty and left the question open rather than quietly keeping a nice sentence.

VIRAENA'S RULING, VERBATIM: NOVA DIED DIED, UNIVERSE BROUGHT HER BACK, THAT'S CANON.

HER FLIGHT ID ALSO CORRECTS IN THE SAME HOUR: 07-005 becomes 07-088. Floaters — boys too unstable to categorise, moved between roles, used as bait, bumped up or down with no warning.

SHE RUNS NOW. A hundred and forty acres she knows in the dark, eight miles before breakfast, and she takes the middle bed on camping trips BECAUSE YOU CAN HEAR EVERYBODY.
